'''Morellian Weapons Conglomerate''' was a weapon firm that created weapons for the [[Morellian Enforcers]] during the [[Old Republic era]]. It consisted of several dozen smaller arms manufacturers that had banded together to share resources and streamline distribution.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Since the company's technology was nowhere near the level of the galactic community, they only produced [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] and projectile weaponry.

An important design from them was the [[.48-caliber Enforcer pistol|Morellian Weapons Conglomerate .48-caliber Enforcer pistol]], which was manufactured in limited quantities for the Enforcers.
